knowledge_point.title: Finding an Entry of a Square Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Find the entry ${b}_{22}$ of the matrix $B$, where 

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -5 \\ -4 & -3\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The entry ${b}_{22}$ lies at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $2$nd column. Therefore, ${b}_{22}=-3.$

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -5 \\ -4 & -3\end{bmatrix}
$$
